record_title: Elliptic-curve control of direct torus sampling for Gashkov-Sidel'nikov decoding
provenance: Refines the recent norm-one-torus decoding description for the original ternary Gashkov-Sidel'nikov codes by exactly counting successful first summands in the direct weight-three search through an explicit genus-one curve.
limitations: The theorem is specific to the characteristic-three norm-one-torus signed-column model of the original Gashkov-Sidel'nikov families. It bounds candidate probes rather than total bit complexity, does not classify the varying elliptic Frobenius traces, and does not claim the same half-density law for all generalized Zetterberg codes or other odd characteristics. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from older Zetterberg decoding literature and near-simultaneous work.
